title: Game Item
description: A comprehensive schema for any item with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the item.

item_type.description: The primary category of the item.

subtype.description: More specific categorization, e.g., 'Lightsaber', 'Heavy Armor', 'Medical Kit'.

era.description: The primary era this item is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: The rarity level of the item.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the item, its history, significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this item.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this item is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: The main descriptive text for the item, providing comprehensive details.

physical_description.description: Detailed physical description of the item's appearance, materials, and construction.

manufacturer.description: The company, organization, or individual who created this item.

manufacturing_location.description: Where this item was typically manufactured or crafted.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Manufactured By', 'Iconic To', 'Restricted To', 'Common Among', 'Created For'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this item from Star Wars canon.

famous_users.description: Notable individuals who have used or owned this type of item.

famous_instances.description: Notable events or moments involving this type of item.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this item.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this item.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this item.

iconic_usage.description: Examples of how this item is typically used in Star Wars stories.

cultural_impact.description: How this item affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

technological_significance.description: The technological implications and significance of this item.

stats.description: Mechanical statistics based on item type.

critical_rating.description: FFG-style rating. Cost in Advantage to trigger a Critical Injury.

properties.description: List of IDs for innate properties from our Property library (e.g., 'finesse', 'vicious').

slots.description: Number of available modification slots (FFG's Hard Points).

compatible_mods.description: List of modification IDs that can be installed on this item.

effects.description: Reusable effects block for items that grant special actions or passive bonuses.

narrative_outcomes.description: List of IDs for valid Advantage/Threat spends when using this item.

tags.description: Tags for filtering and applying properties, e.g., ['weapon', 'ranged', 'blaster'].

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this item.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this item.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this item, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this item adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Combat_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this item is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the item's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the item's icon for UI display.
